name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Mandate that the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) auto-generates the top 3 contradictions *immediately* after every creative brief is locked. This forces clarity before production starts, cutting rework from downstream teams. The trade-off is a slight delay in brief finalization, but it prevents the far costlier delays of misaligned execution.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t the 30-second delay—it’s that auto-generating contradictions embeds bias before the brief is even challenged. Instead, mandate that the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) surfaces the *top 3 assumptions* in the brief for human review, not contradictions. Settle the argument by testing both: measure whether assumption review reduces rework more than contradiction generation does.
